Reflection.title: Reflection
Reflection.description: A user-authored journal reflection entry with multi-turn AI dialogue and sentiment metadata

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the owner

content.description: Body text of the journal reflection

summary.description: AI-generated executive summary of the reflection

tags.description: Tags associated with the reflection themes

mood.description: User-selected mood state (e.g., thoughtful, grateful, calm)

sentimentScore.description: Gemini-analyzed sentiment score on a 1-5 scale (1=Very Heavy/Negative, 3=Neutral/Reflective, 5=Very Positive/Joyful)

sentimentLabel.description: Descriptive sentiment category (Positive, Neutral, Negative, etc.)

sentimentReasoning.description: Brief rationale for the sentiment breakdown for user self-awareness

location.description: Optional opt-in geolocation metadata attached by user with lat, lng, placeName, and address

placeName.description: Display name of the location or point of interest

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when reflection was last modified (milliseconds)

messages.description: Multi-turn Gemini dialogue messages associated with this reflection

/users/{userId}/reflections/{reflectionI.description: Private, user-isolated collection of reflections and AI dialogues
